rationale: Price reached a session high of $144.29 on the latest 1-minute bar, missing the $144.30 take-profit target by just one cent before pulling back to $144.09. Holding from $144.09 exposes $1.09 per share of downside to the $143.00 invalidation level to capture only $0.21 per share of remaining upside to the target, creating an unfavorable forward risk-to-reward profile. Closing now locks in the bulk of the breakout move.
